lines.3: 「The distance between you and me. We're sitting incredibly far apart.」
lines.5: 「It is more like Japan to South America.」
lines.6: 「Right. You really seem to hate me.」
lines.7: 「Not particularly. I am like this with everyone.」
lines.8: 「...I'm counting on that tough spirit of yours. I have a favor to ask.」
lines.13: Her narrow eyes have a piercing gaze.
lines.15: Actually, I end up looking away first.
lines.18: No matter. Time for an indirect approach.
lines.19: 「What sort of things do you like, Miss Yashi?」
lines.20: 「Someone on the student council might share your interests.」
lines.21: 「Then we could all have fun together, right?」
lines.26: 「And while we are on the subject, what I dislike is interference.」
lines.29: 「You look calm, Senpai, but you're pretty small-time.」
lines.30: 「Seriously, do you treat everyone besides me like this too?」
lines.31: 「I am only being aggressive now because you are trying to drag me into something.」
lines.32: 「Normally, I engage in the minimum necessary communication. Do not concern yourself.」
lines.35: Yashi walks off with her nose in the air.
